weight_trial.description: One effective down-projection weight edit at all tokens. Directly optimized rank-one value; update removed after each trial. First two rows are held-out rewrite prompts; last four are retention prompts.

ica: FastICA on the first six PCA scores. Axes and signs fixed on the reference bank.
pca: Axes of greatest variance on the reference bank.
ace: Rank-one activation–gradient fit, with the leading left singular vector of centered activations times the gradient matrix mapped back into activation space.
means: Direction from the class 0 mean to the class 1 mean.
neurons: Native channels in 16. Display candidates chosen by the absolute reference mean gap, before looking at the replay.
group: Six native Qwen coordinates chosen on the separate a/an discovery split. One member per block. This is a functional cohort with a shared contrast. A graph-discovered community could have different membership.
features: 64 features, top eight active, fitted to predict the MLP output in block 16. Held-out fraction of variance explained 12.2%. Feature IDs are local to this fit.
raw: Final normalization and model output head. Full vocabulary, ranked before any token exclusion.
skeleton_full: Forward-only leave-once fit, pooled carrier. All three branches share the fixed vocabulary exclusion list. Ranks are within that vocabulary.
skeleton_same: Forward-only leave-once fit, pooled carrier. All three branches share the fixed vocabulary exclusion list. Ranks are within that vocabulary.
skeleton_tail: Forward-only leave-once fit, pooled carrier. All three branches share the fixed vocabulary exclusion list. Ranks are within that vocabulary.
J: Released matrix for this checkpoint and layer. Vocabulary uses the frozen exclusion list for the corresponding release.
J++: Released matrix for this checkpoint and layer. Vocabulary uses the frozen exclusion list for the corresponding release.
R: Released matrix for this checkpoint and layer. Vocabulary uses the frozen exclusion list for the corresponding release.
J-1000: Released matrix for this checkpoint and layer. Vocabulary uses the frozen exclusion list for the corresponding release.
gradient: Average of the gradients of the stated output contrast over the labelled reference inputs.
gradient_ranked_ica: ICA axis selected by the largest mean squared directional derivative of the stated output contrast.
attention: Block 19. Each head’s causal softmax over actual key positions for this query. Key indices start at zero.
heads: Block 19. Norms of each gated head before the output projection.
patch: Full-residual copy for transplant cases; article conditions edit post-gate neurons across six blocks.
functions: Four reference queries with four demonstrations. Flip the example labels, then restore one head at a time. Select the head with the greatest mean recovery in the correct-label margin. Read the cosine to that head’s mean projected output on the clean and edited state. A weak discovery result is visible below.
rome: How strongly would a rank-one weight write fire here? Form the key from class 0 reference MLP inputs, adjust for a regularized second moment over independent passages, then normalize its response on that key to one. These scores concern the input side of a weight edit. The Rome exhibit also includes a separate effective weight-write trial.
oracle: A small learned adapter reads the frozen source state into a frozen language model with two token-recovery questions. The fit uses independent passages; the shuffled-state and question-only controls appear beneath the predictions. This tests lexical recovery, a much narrower task than a general activation oracle.
future: Copy the state into a fixed recipient, force “ the” after it, and read the following token. This is a hard-prompt future-token diagnostic.
patchscope: Replace X in a fixed three-example identity receiver; let the model read the arrow after X. A literal copied clue is a possible result.
tuned: Residual translator trained against the model’s final distribution with full-vocabulary KL. Held-out KL 7.31 raw and 4.75 after translation, on 24 positions from three other passages.
probe: Binary linear ridge fitted on labelled references. Compare the signed score on the replay. These reference scores are in-sample.
graph: For each active transcoder feature, activation × decoder direction projected onto the local gradient of the final margin. A first-order output attribution at one position.
geometry: Cosine similarity to each reference class centroid, in native activation coordinates.
